paper.title: Quantum error correction below the surface code threshold

result.summary: 本文在超导量子处理器上实现了低于阈值的表面码量子纠错。作者在105量子比特处理器上运行距离-7表面码，在72量子比特处理器上运行距离-5表面码并集成实时解码器 [S1.p3]。距离-7码的逻辑错误率随码距增加而指数抑制，错误抑制因子Λ=2.14±0.02，每周期逻辑错误率为0.143%±0.003%，且其寿命超过最佳物理量子比特寿命2.4±0.3倍 [abstract]。作者还通过距离-29重复码探测到约每小时发生一次的关联错误事件，将当前逻辑错误下限设定在10^-10 [S1.p3]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在实现并验证表面码量子纠错在物理错误率低于阈值条件下的运行，从而展示逻辑错误率随码距增加而指数抑制的特性 [S1.p1]。原文指出，尽管许多平台展示了量子纠错的不同特征，但尚无量子处理器明确展示低于阈值的性能 [S1.p1]。此外，容错量子计算还要求系统在数小时时间尺度上保持稳定，并实时解码综合征信息 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: While many platforms have demonstrated different features of quantum error correction, no quantum processor has definitively shown below-threshold performance.
These include features like stability over the hours-long timescales of quantum algorithms and the active removal of correlated error sources like leakage.
Fault-tolerant quantum computing also imposes requirements on classical coprocessors – namely, the syndrome information produced by the quantum device must be decoded as fast as it is generated.

method.text: 作者在105量子比特处理器上实现距离-7表面码，在72量子比特处理器上实现距离-5表面码并集成实时解码器 [S1.p3]。表面码操作包括将数据量子比特制备在X_L或Z_L基态，重复纠错循环提取奇偶信息，并在每个综合征提取后运行数据量子比特泄漏移除（DQLR）[S2.p3]。解码方面，作者使用神经网络解码器和集成匹配合成解码器，并通过处理器数据微调神经网络、对匹配图权重进行强化学习优化 [S2.p2]。实时解码系统采用基于Sparse Blossom算法的多线程实现，使用恒定大小的图缓冲区和块并行化策略 [S5.p2]。

evidence.quote: Using a 72-qubit processor, we implement a distance-5 surface code operating with an integrated real-time decoder.
In addition, using a 105-qubit processor with similar performance, we realize a distance-7 surface code.
We then repeat a variable number of cycles of error correction, during which measure qubits extract parity information from the data qubits to be sent to the decoder.
Following each syndrome extraction, we run data qubit leakage removal (DQLR) to ensure that leakage to higher states is short-lived.
One is a neural network decoder, and the other is a harmonized ensemble of correlated minimum-weight perfect matching decoders augmented with matching synthesis.
To adapt to device noise, we fine-tune the neural network with processor data and apply a reinforcement learning optimization to the matching graph weights.

We employ a specialized version of the Sparse Blossom algorithm optimized to quickly resolve local configurations of errors common in surface code decoding, using a parallelization strategy similar to Ref..

The decoder operates on a constant-sized graph buffer which emulates the section of the error graph being decoded at any instant, but which does not grow with the total number of cycles used in the experiment.

experiments.text: 实验在105量子比特和72量子比特超导处理器上进行，105量子比特处理器用于距离-7表面码，72量子比特处理器用于距离-5表面码和距离-29重复码 [S1.p3][S4.p2]。表面码逻辑性能通过拟合最多250个纠错周期的每周期逻辑错误率来表征，距离-3和距离-5子网格分别平均9个和4个不同子网格 [S2.p5]。重复码实验运行距离-29码1000个周期，共2×10^7次采样，总计2×10^10个纠错周期，耗时5.5小时 [S4.p2]。实时解码实验在72量子比特处理器上运行距离-5表面码，测试最多10^6个周期，周期时间为1.1微秒 [S5.p3][S5.p1]。

evidence.quote: Using a 72-qubit processor, we implement a distance-5 surface code operating with an integrated real-time decoder.
In addition, using a 105-qubit processor with similar performance, we realize a distance-7 surface code.
Using our 72-qubit processor, we run a distance-29 repetition code for 1000 cycles of error correction over $2\times 10^{7}$ shots split evenly between bit- and phase-flip codes.
In total, we execute $2\times 10^{10}$ cycles of error correction comprising 5.5 hours of processor execution time.
We characterize our surface code logical performance by fitting the logical error per cycle $\varepsilon_{d}$ up to 250 cycles, averaged over the $X$ and $Z$ bases.
We average the performance of 9 different distance-3 subgrids and 4 different distance-5 subgrids to compare to the distance-7 code.
For our distance-5 surface code, we test different problem sizes by increasing the number of error correction cycles up to $10^{6}$.
The throughput of transmitting, processing, and decoding the syndrome information in each cycle must keep pace with the fast error correcting cycle time of 1.1 µs.

findings.text: 距离-7表面码的逻辑错误率随码距增加而指数抑制，使用神经网络解码器时错误抑制因子Λ=2.14±0.02，每周期逻辑错误率ε_7=(1.43±0.03)×10^-3 [S2.p5]。距离-7逻辑量子比特寿命为291±6微秒，超过所有组成物理量子比特的寿命（中位数85±7微秒，最佳119±13微秒）2.4±0.3倍 [S2.p7]。实时解码在距离-5下保持低于阈值性能，平均解码延迟为63±17微秒，且不随实验长度增加而增长 [S5.p3]。距离-29重复码在d=5到11之间获得错误抑制因子Λ=8.4±0.1，但在d≥15时出现偏离指数抑制，逻辑错误下限约为10^-10，由约每小时发生一次的关联错误爆发导致 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。

evidence.quote: With our neural network decoder, we observe $\Lambda=2.14\pm 0.02$ and $\varepsilon_{7}$ = $(1.43\pm 0.03)\times 10^{-3}$ (see Fig. 1 c-d).
The distance-7 logical qubit lifetime is $291\pm 6$ µs, exceeding the lifetimes of all the constituent physical qubits (median $85\pm 7$ µs, best $119\pm 13$ µs) by a factor of $2.4\pm 0.3$.

We observe that the average latency remains roughly constant at a net average of $63\pm 17$ µs independent of the length of the experiment (up to 1.1 seconds), indicating that the decoding problem is being processed in real time.

Averaging over bit- and phase-flip repetition codes, we obtain an error suppression factor $\Lambda=8.4\pm 0.1$ when fitting logical error per cycle versus code distance between $d=5$ and 11, as shown in Fig. 3 a.
However, at code distances $d\geq 15$, we observe a deviation from exponential error suppression at high distances culminating in an apparent logical error floor of $10^{-10}$.
They occur approximately once an hour, rather than once every few seconds, and they decay with an exponential time constant around 400 µs, rather than tens of milliseconds.

limitations.text: 作者指出，尽管原则上可以通过扩大当前处理器规模实现低逻辑错误率，但在实践中资源消耗巨大；外推预测显示，达到10^-6错误率需要距离-27逻辑量子比特，使用1457个物理量子比特 [S6.p3]。重复码实验识别出由关联错误爆发导致的10^-10噪声下限，作者表示尚未理解这些事件的成因，但缓解它们对构建容错量子计算机至关重要 [S4.p4][S6.p3]。此外，实时解码的精度相比离线解码器有适度降低，且随着码距增加，每周期综合征测量数呈二次增长，将带来额外挑战 [S5.p4][S6.p3]。

evidence.quote: Extrapolating the projections in Fig. 1 d, achieving a $10^{-6}$ error rate would require a distance-27 logical qubit using 1457 physical qubits.
Scaling up will also bring additional challenges in real-time decoding as the syndrome measurements per cycle increase quadratically with code distance.
We do not yet understand the cause of these events, but mitigating them remains vital to building a fault-tolerant quantum computer.
Our repetition code experiments also identify a noise floor at an error rate of $10^{-10}$ caused by correlated bursts of errors.
The modest reduction in accuracy when comparing the real-time decoder to an offline decoder is expected as the real-time decoder must operate significantly faster.
